seoDescription: Fort Bend ISD 2025-2026 calendar summary with Aug 12 first day, May 28 last day, Fall Break, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, Spring Break and early release dates.
calendarNotes: Fort Bend ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 12, 2025 and lists May 28, 2026 as the last day for students. Fall Break runs October 13-17, Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 16-20. The 2025-2026 source package did not include an official public PDF URL; this summary uses the official Fort Bend ISD calendar page and a local reference PDF generated from verified district calendar data.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fort Bend ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fort Bend ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on Tuesday, August 12, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 13 through Friday, October 17, 2025. Students return for the second nine weeks on Tuesday, October 21 after a teacher planning day on October 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Bend ISD Winter Break 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026. Students return for second semester classes on Thursday, January 8, 2026 after teacher work, professional learning, and teacher planning days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Fort Bend ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fort Bend ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Thursday, May 28, 2026, with early release for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: Is there an official Fort Bend ISD 2025-2026 PDF URL?
calendarFaqs.a: No official 2025-2026 PDF URL was provided with the source package. MySchoolDates used the Fort Bend ISD calendar page and a local reference PDF generated from verified district calendar information.
